body: Open-source observability for your GenAI or LLM application, based on OpenTelemetry
plain_description: OpenLLMetry gives you complete visibility into how your LLM application is performing, from prompt to response. It connects to the monitoring tools you already use — Datadog, New Relic, and 20+ others — so you don't need to learn a new platform. One line of code gets you started.
technical_description: OpenLLMetry is a set of OpenTelemetry extensions that instrument LLM applications for observability. It provides auto-instrumentation for major LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock, etc.), vector databases (Chroma, Pinecone, Qdrant, etc.), and AI frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, etc.). The SDK outputs standard OpenTelemetry trace data compatible with any OpenTelemetry collector or observability backend. Instrumentation is installed via pip and initialized with a single Python call.
title: OpenLLMetry
